name: Alpha-1-antitrypsin
milestone: Deficiency discovered in patients with emphysema (Laurell & Eriksson)
blurb: Protease inhibitor that protects the lungs from neutrophil elastase.

misfolded.name: Z alpha-1-antitrypsin polymers
misfolded.description: The Z variant opens up and links into long chains (polymers) that clog the ER of liver cells, while too little reaches the lungs. A 'serpinopathy': misfolding without amyloid.

function: Inhibitor of serine proteases. Its primary target is elastase, but it also has a moderate affinity for plasmin and thrombin. Irreversibly inhibits trypsin, chymotrypsin and plasminogen activator. The aberrant form inhibits insulin-induced NO synthesis in platelets, decreases coagulation time and has proteolytic activity against insulin and plasmin
